_comment: Matches the REAL existing 'Poland 2026' tab column layout in your tracker exactly. UNIFIED 2026-08-14 to match USA's standard column order/keys, per explicit instruction ('same the UK, poland tab as USA... Follow the USA tab as standard one'). Two deliberate, user-approved exceptions to a literal 1:1 match with USA (confirmed via AskUserQuestion before this ran): (1) Poland keeps its own 'VAT' column (real historical amounts, currently all 0 -- see the tax rate change below) even though USA has no VAT column; placed right after Total Amount, same relative position as before. (2) USA's 'State' and Poland's 'Country' are different concepts (US state vs client's own country -- Poland's real data here is things like 'Switzerland'/'Austria', i.e. the CLIENT's country, not Poland itself) that just happen to sit in the same column position (3) -- kept as its own tab-specific header/key rather than merged into one. Physically restructured on the real device file 2026-08-14 via scripts/surgical_unify_uk_poland.py (raw-XML surgical patch -- every other sheet, including India, verified byte-for-byte untouched; backup saved alongside the real file as 'Invoice Traker_BACKUP_2026-08-14_pre-uk-poland-unify.xlsx'). Two real cell comments on the PF ID column (accountant notes about invoice recipients) were remapped to follow PF ID's new position -- see that script's fix_poland_comments().
_tax_rate_change_note: VAT rate changed 2026-08-14 from 0.0 to 0.20, per explicit instruction ('for USA keep the tax percent is 0, & 20 for others') -- 'others' = UK AND Poland now both charge 20%, matching UK's existing rate. This ONLY affects future invoices' tax calculation; Poland's 76 existing real rows keep their real historical VAT figures (all 0, correctly reflecting what was actually charged at the time) untouched.
_two_phase_flow_note: 'Invoice Description' / 'Client Mail To' / 'INT CC Mail' used to be TRAILING columns (added after-the-fact for the two-phase flow) -- moved 2026-08-14 to sit right after Company Name, matching where USA already has them. 'Currency' used to sit right after Company Name (position 9) -- moved to the trailing position, matching where USA/UK already have it.
_mis_verified_note: 'MIS Verified' (2026-08-12) is set by the real MIS project-info API call made right when the row is appended (see src/mis/mis_api.py) -- True only if that call actually succeeded for the row's PF ID; False (never blocks the append) if the API failed, timed out, or the token was expired, so accounts knows to check that project ID by hand.
_department_received_amount_note: 'Department' and 'Received amount' added 2026-08-14 as part of the USA-layout unification -- Poland never had either column before. Historical rows are blank in both, same policy as every other trailing/inserted column added so far.
